newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market to trade six stocks this week.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market to trade six stocks this week.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market system, which went on stream last Friday, will trade six stocks throughout the week and make the first results known on Friday, a system official said on Monday.

Mihai Catuneanu, RASDAQ system manager, said the six stocks -- including a construction company, a medicine distributor, a jewellery making company and a plane engine maker -- would be traded in daily two-hour sessions from Monday to Friday.
The RASDAQ was modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ under a U.S. Agency for International Development capital market project.
Only two stocks -- Turbomecanica SA plane engine maker and Bijuteria SA jeweller -- traded last Friday, Catuneanu said, without giving other details.
He said the number of securities companies involved in trading had already risen to 15 from four.
Around 74 RASDAQ dealers and brokers are eventually expected to trade shares in some 5,000 companies, most of them turned private under a mass selloff.
Market sources said 150 companies had been selected for early OTC trading but considerable time was required to sign a contract with the shareholders' registry.

Catuneanu said that problem had been solved recently when the capital market regulator CNVM issued rules saying companies turned private under the mass selloff programme automatically became clients of the registry.
"This clears the way for more entries to the RASDAQ system in the weeks ahead," Catuneanu said.
Under a mass selloff launched a year ago, 15 million Romanians swapped privatisation paper for around 600 million shares in 4,000 state companies. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
